svg.text: Something that first seems unfortunate but
later turns out to be beneficial.
Missing that flight was a blessing in disguise: it
gave me an extra day with my family.
Use a blessing in disguise, not a disguised
blessing. Usually retrospective; do not use it to
dismiss someone’s pain before a benefit is
A: I was disappointed when the trip was
B: Did anything good come of it?

B: I can see why you feel differently about it
